### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**18** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json`, `packages/spec/src/data/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json`, `packages/spec/src/data/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0e4b0fa411de344a0c2f38500255c68fc1cdfdf2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `151d96804ae7c5cabfb8a3cb3587987781e9eb00` — the merge of head `4ee136f065201c8f6edbd7856a651ac212b2f86b` into base `0e4b0fa411de344a0c2f38500255c68fc1cdfdf2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 151d96804ae7c5cabfb8a3cb3587987781e9eb00 && git checkout 151d96804ae7c5cabfb8a3cb3587987781e9eb00
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0e4b0fa411de344a0c2f38500255c68fc1cdfdf2 4ee136f065201c8f6edbd7856a651ac212b2f86b && git checkout -B drift-repro 0e4b0fa411de344a0c2f38500255c68fc1cdfdf2 && git merge --no-ff 4ee136f065201c8f6edbd7856a651ac212b2f86b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0e4b0fa411de344a0c2f38500255c68fc1cdfdf2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

Read-only: no worktree, build, test or gate was run; the dev report's local-run table was not an input to any judgment.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Same change, file by file.** The seven paths are the same set in both net diffs, and five of the seven are the same blob at both heads: `unique-null-distinct-conformance.ts` (`3b9bca66`), its test (`95d5b585`), the changeset (`41726e9e`), `scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs` (`6d2649e8`) are identical bytes, and the diff-of-diffs over `index.ts`, the two source files, the test, the changeset and the census is empty but for one hunk header on `index.ts` (`@@ -144` became `@@ -149`: main added `export { isListComparandOperator }` five lines above, commit df8d0208). The `index.ts` hunk itself (the comment and the `export * from './unique-null-distinct-conformance'` line, between `value-roundtrip-conformance` and `date-macros.zod`) is the same text. The two generated files differ from `0c0e86d0` only because main moved them: against each head's own base the hunk adds exactly the same four lines (`UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT_CASES (const)`, `UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT_OBJECTS (const)`, `UniqueNullDistinctCase (interface)`, `uniqueNullDistinctDivergence (function)` in api-surface; the four `src/data/unique-null-distinct-conformance.ts#…` origins in export-origins) at the same alphabetical slots, three lines lower. No hunk differs in content; the net diff carries nothing the merges brought that is not on main (the net stat is the same +594/−6 over the same seven paths).
2. **Main did not move what the earlier record read.** Between the old base `6af3d295` and `origin/main` @ `0e4b0fa4` (179 commits) zero commits touch `scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs` (blob `a4ecf114` at both bases and on main), `packages/types/src/unique-violation.ts`, `memory-unique-constraint.ts`, `memory-driver.ts`, `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`, `schema-drift.ts`, `mongodb-schema.ts`, `mongodb-driver.ts`, `mongodb-unique-null-distinct.test.ts`, `odata-driver.ts`, `value-roundtrip-conformance.ts` or `readable-ids-conformance.ts`. The one commit on `sql-driver.ts` (3ff7fb7a, the list-comparand split) adds or removes no line naming unique, UNIQUE or an index. The four commits on `field.zod.ts` and three on `object.zod.ts` change no `unique`, `indexes` or `nullSafe` line (one TSDoc sentence mentions "unique-covered"); `UniqueScopeSchema` and the declared-index shape the fixtures parse through are as the earlier record read them, so ① items 2 to 4 and 7 of 6583589505 hold on this base.
3. **Census and ledger still reconcile on this base.** `origin/main` exports eleven `*_CASES` constants from `*-conformance.ts` under `spec/src/data` (AGGREGATION, FILTER_COMPARAND_TYPE, FILTER_LOGIC, FILTER_TEXT, PAGINATION, PAGINATION_UNORDERED, PAGINATION_ZERO_LIMIT, READABLE_IDS, TEMPORAL, TEMPORAL_TIME, VALUE_ROUNDTRIP); the head's `CASE_SETS` names those eleven plus `UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT_CASES`, and no other `*-conformance.ts` on main exports a `_CASES` name (`bulk-write-hook-conformance.ts` was present at the old base and exports none). `packages/drivers/` on main is still the six packages the six DEBT rows name (memory, mongodb, odata, sql, sqlite-wasm, turso); no driver was added or removed. CLASSIFIED and RECONCILED hold as they did.
4. **`packages/spec/src/data/index.ts` exports: no collision.** `git grep` on `origin/main` for the four names and for `unique-null-distinct` matches no file content, and the only paths spelled that way are `packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-unique-null-distinct.test.ts` and `.changeset/29278-mongodb-unique-null-distinct.md` (the #29339 changeset); main's one addition to the barrel (`isListComparandOperator`) is a different name at a different slot. The head's generated api-surface and export-origins equal main's plus exactly the four names, which is what `check:generated` must find current.
5. **The merge commits are clean.** `e953a404` and `ea07aeb0` are the only commits between `0c0e86d0` and the regen commit `4ee136f0`; the net diff against main shows the seven paths and nothing else, so neither merge dropped a main-side hunk or carried a branch-side one outside the claim's surface.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec`: `patch`, unchanged. Changeset and PR body both declare `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initially, agreeing with the claim 6595859623. Read against `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` on main: the level is decided by the `Metadata-protocol:` kind alone (`none` grades every introduced entry `patch`; the `yes (widening)` arm is read for the contract-review face and the ADR-0087 signal, and its self-test pins `yes (widening)` beside `none` as `none-clean`), and a declared `none` is refused only when a `packages/spec/authorable-surface/` or `authorable-defaults/` shard moves (`PROTOCOL_BASELINE_ROOTS`). `packages/spec/api-surface/` and `export-origins/` are in neither root, so the moved api-surface shard is invisible to that gate, as it should be: it records a public-surface widening, not an authorable key. AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 says the same (a non-protocol widening ships `patch`). Check Changeset on this head concluded success. No ADR-0087 disposition is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **PR-body guards job is red on this head, on a condition that has since cleared, not on the diff.** Job 125750359932 (run 41585645467, started 05:44:20Z) failed with "#29377 is already claimed by #29509 (draft)"; PR #29509 was closed at 05:47:07Z, three minutes after the run started. Landing step for the seat: trigger the re-run (an edit to the PR body suffices) and read it green before arming; no head change is needed. - **Ruling 6595804527 (letter A) is applied as ruled:** the census row and the six DEBT rows are byte-identical to the head that record 6583589505 judged and the Decision-needed described; nothing was added, dropped or re-worded. The `⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY` marker on ledger growth is satisfied by the maintainer's 「同意」 on that comment, and the PR body carries `Ruling-ref: 6595804527`.
- **Not a governed-surface PR:** no path under `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` or `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`; the Governed Surface Queue Guard concluded success. Head repo is `objectstack-ai/objectstack` (not a fork).
- **Check-runs on `4ee136f0`, polled to completion, last read 2026-11-03T06:10:12Z:** 64 runs, 0 pending, 54 success, 9 skipped, 1 failure, 0 cancelled. The one failure is the PR-body guards job above.
